About

Incorporated in 1999, TGB Banquets & Hotels Ltd provides restaurants, banquets and hotel services.[1]

Key Points

Business Overview:[1][2]
TGBBHL is a three-star hotel property located in Ahmedabad under the name
The Grand Bhagwati Hotel. It provides outside catering service and operates
restaurants & food courts. Its banquet services consist of managing various
events, weddings, exhibitions, and parties
